title: 第10章 华夏的文化宣传从芒果开始
novel_title: 我在星际召唤古人，带飞华夏文明
content_zh:
内容很简单，是一个生活在海岛上的小芒果对着天空许愿。

    它期盼自己快快长大，这样成熟后才能落地孕育新的芒果。

    其余芒果也是如此，大家的愿望都相同。

    可某一天，小芒果在快要成熟的那一刻，岸边忽然停靠了一个庞然大物。

    大物上走下来一群奇怪的生物。

    这些生物说着小芒果听不懂的话，在岛上四处寻找，很快发现树上的小芒果。

    他们发出惊呼，大着胆子尝了一口。

    觉得味道不错又没毒，便把芒果树上的芒果摘了一些准备带离海岛，其中就包含小芒果。

    漫画到这里结束，最后一排写着‘欲知后事如何，请看下回分解’。

    林蒹葭看完漫画觉得挺有意思，也被下一话勾得心头痒痒，更对卡片和店铺所说的‘华夏’产生了兴趣。

    芒果她知道，传闻来自于阿三国的水果，但如何传入花国的却不清楚。

    漫画标题说小芒果是如何传入华夏的，用的语言却是花国语。

    难道这个‘华夏’是花国的谐音吗？

    林蒹葭猜不透，把漫画卡片放好，拿起一个芒果嗅了嗅。

    果味很浓，和精品水果店卖得差不多。

    她被馋得连忙剥了一个芒果塞进嘴里，甘甜多汁，入口即化，像是奶油冰淇淋。

    “什么啊，芒果怎么能这么好吃。”

    林蒹葭被芒果的美味惊到，点开店铺，确保是才注册不到一个小时的新店铺。

    她看了看手上被啃完只剩下芒果核的芒果，又看了眼店铺名字和价格，默默点上关注并打了一个好评。

    她还发了朋友圈宣传，将漫画和芒果发出去，额外备注这是来自“华夏店铺”的水果。

    ......

    滴答一声，正在树下捡果子的花期，听到后台响应点开一看瞬间乐了。

    芒果上架还不到两分钟，就有人下单了七斤，并正好是花国人。

    花期立马放下芒果，在星际版的拼夕夕同城上花了二十块下单了一百个纸箱和泡沫箱，以及九块九一盒的水彩笔和五百张A6卡片。

    同城的快递能用光速形容，差不多十分钟，她就收到一个大箱子和一个小箱子。

    照样给了快递员好评，花期马上找出水彩笔和卡片。
content_en:
The content is very simple. It is a little mango living on an island making a wish to the sky.

    It hopes that it will grow up quickly so that when it matures, it can fall to the ground and give birth to new mangoes.

    The same goes for the rest of the mangoes, and everyone has the same wish.

    But one day, when the little mango was about to mature, a huge thing suddenly docked on the shore.

    A group of strange creatures walked down from the big thing.

    These creatures spoke words that Little Mango could not understand, and searched around the island, and soon found Little Mango on the tree.

    They exclaimed and dared to take a bite.

    I thought it tasted good and was not poisonous, so I picked some mangoes from the mango tree and prepared to take them away from the island, including small mangoes.

    The comic ends here, and the last line says, 'If you want to know what happens next, please read the breakdown next time.'

    After reading the comic, Lin Jianjia found it quite interesting, and was intrigued by the next chapter. She became even more interested in the "China" mentioned in the card and the store.

    She knew about mangoes, which were rumored to come from the Asan Kingdom, but she didn't know how they were introduced to the Flower Kingdom.

    The title of the comic tells how the little mango was introduced to China, but the language used is Hua Mandarin.

    Is this 'Huaxia' the homophone of the flower country?

    Lin Jianjia couldn't guess, so she put the comic card away, picked up a mango and sniffed it.

    The fruity flavor is very strong, similar to what is sold in boutique fruit shops.

    She was so greedy that she quickly peeled a mango and stuffed it into her mouth. It was sweet and juicy and melted in her mouth, like creamy ice cream.

    "What, how can mango be so delicious?"

    Lin Jianjia was surprised by the delicious taste of mango. She clicked on the store and made sure it was a new store that had been registered less than an hour ago.

    She looked at the mango in her hand that had been chewed up and only the core was left, then looked at the store name and price, silently clicked on it and gave it a good review.

    She also posted on WeChat Moments to promote the product, handing out comics and mangoes, with an additional note that these were fruits from a "Chinese store".

    ...

    There was a ticking sound, and I was picking up fruits under the tree during the flower season. When I heard the response in the background and clicked on it, I was instantly happy.

    Less than two minutes after the mangoes were put on the shelves, someone placed an order for seven pounds, and he happened to be from Huaguo.

    Huaqi immediately put down Mango and spent 20 yuan on the interstellar version of Pinxixi.com to order 100 cartons and foam boxes, as well as 9 yuan and 91 boxes of watercolor pens and 500 A6 cards.

    The express delivery in the same city can be described at the speed of light. In almost ten minutes, she received a large box and a small box.

    I still gave the courier a good review, and Hua Qi immediately found the watercolor pens and cards.
title_en: Chapter 10 China’s cultural propaganda starts with mangoes
